description: Studs at 16 or 24 in on center for a wall length, plus extras for corners and openings, and linear feet of top and bottom plate. Formula: Studs on layout = ⌈length(in) ÷ spacing⌉ + 1; total = layout + corners × extras per corner + openings × extras per opening. Plate linear ft = length × plates.

spacing_in.description: Stud spacing (on center); default 16; one of 16 = 16 in o.c., 24 = 24 in o.c., 12 = 12 in o.c.

name: calc_wall_stud
title: Wall Stud Calculator (Studs & Plates for a Framed Wall)
